unavail._comment: The third state, added 2026-09-12 [R-071]/[R-072]: not 'fine' and not 'broken' but 'never measured'. Before these strings existed, a roster that could not read a log rendered as an empty roster and a lag scan that read zero bytes rendered as 'no lag recorded'. 'why' carries the sentence from lib\rk-capabilities.psd1 verbatim (English on purpose - it is the contract's own wording, and one source beats two translations drifting apart).
